# Arcadia Micro Structures

> Arcadia Micro Structures designs and builds prefabricated backyard studios and micro structures — used as income suites, hospitality units, and flexible backyard living space.

Arcadia works with homeowners and property investors to add standalone backyard structures that can serve as rental income suites, guest/hospitality units, or extra living space, backed by financing options.

## Pages
- [Backyard Studios](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/backyard-studios/): Core product — prefabricated backyard studio structures.
- [Income Suites](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/income-suites/): Structures positioned for rental income use cases.
- [Hospitality](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/hospitality/): Structures for short-term rental / hospitality use.
- [Financing](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/financing/): Financing options for a backyard structure purchase.
- [Gallery](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/gallery/): Photos of completed structures.
- [FAQ](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/faq/): Common questions.
- [Mission](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/mission/): Company mission/story.
- [Contact](https://arcadiamicrostructures.com/contact/): Get in touch.
